links.outcome: Reading grade level and understandability/actionability with versus without prompt engineering (incontinence domain)
links.effect: Reading level improved from grade 12.4 to 5.4 (P<.01); actionability 38.3% to 93.5% (P<.001); understandability 89.6% to 96.2% (P<.001); misinformation unchanged.
links.quote: Using prompt engineering in the incontinence domain, scores for DISCERN (3.57-4.75, P = .007), PEMAT-P understandability (89.6% to 96.2%, P < .001), actionability (38.3% to 93.5%, P < .001), and reading level (grade 12.4-5.4, P < .01) all improved significantly while misinformation and word count did not change significantly.
